description: The package provides Python code and harmonised inputs for stochastic life-cycle assessment of hydrogen infrastructure. The depositor describes Monte Carlo uncertainty, Sobol sensitivity, infrastructure-age profiles and spatial correlations. The provider is Charabi, Yassine. Coverage: The description uses the September 2025 IEA Global Hydrogen Database and aggregates project identities by region and technology. Exact asset coverage and computational resolution require the files. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: Confidential project identities are aggregated. Claims of mass-balance checks and reproducibility come from the depositor and were not independently tested. For simulation it supports uncertainty and sensitivity experiments for infrastructure emissions and technology choices. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
